_comment: Copy to config.json in the skill root and edit. Everything is optional — with no config the skill just asks.
_birth_time_comment: Only needed for moon/rising/house questions. Local time at the birth city.
_system_comment: western (sun sign) | vedic (rashi/moon sign, the Indian default) | both
_rashi_comment: Your Vedic moon sign, if you know it. In India this is what 'my sign' means.

preferences._period_comment: daily | weekly | monthly — the default when the user doesn't say

_people_comment: Other signs to read for, by name. Used for 'read for me and my partner' or compatibility questions.
